title: enhance-quarantine-probing-autorollback-workflow-for-unified-rollouts
author: Asha Patel
ci_status: pass (build: pass, unit-tests: pass, lint: pass after fix, e2e: pass)
description: Context: This PR improves the quarantine/probing stage and the automatic rollback decision path in the unified rollouts engine. Motivation: Recently we saw flakiness in multi-metric quorum decisions during staged shadow + canary rollouts (SEE ENG-2145). This change tightens the quarantine logic, adds quorum-backed probing, introduces an adaptive timeout for probes, and ties the autorollback decision to a composite metric with configurable thresholds. What changed (summary): - Add a QuarantineCoordinator that centralizes manual and automatic quarantine decisions and exposes a small reconciliation loop. - Introduce ProbingPolicy that supports conditional re-tries, probe weight decay, and adaptive timeouts based on observed latency distributions. - Change autorollback evaluator to use composite-metric scoring (latency p95 + error-rate + quality-regression) with quorum rules. - Add new observability signals: rollback_decision_reason, quarantine_duration_ms, probe_retry_count, composite_score. - Add e2e test harness to exercise staged shadow -> canary -> quarantine -> autorollback flow. Backwards compatibility: New config knobs are optional and default to previous behavior. Customers pinning rollout policies will not see behavioral changes unless they opt into the new ProbingPolicy. Migration: No migration required for existing rollout objects; new behavior enabled via rollout.spec.probing.v2 = true. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-2145) - [x] Unit tests for QuarantineCoordinator and ProbingPolicy - [x] Integration tests for multi-stage rollouts - [x] Observability dashboards + alerts updated - [x] E2E tests against local canary harness - [x] Manual canary verification in staging (performed) Tests and validation: Unit + integration pipeline passing. E2E run in staging with synthetic traffic and fault injection showed expected quarantine and rollback within threshold for injected regressions. Rollout plan: Feature gated behind probing.v2 flag; gradually enable for internal teams, then opt-in beta customers, then default after 2 weeks of monitoring. Related: builds on prior autorollback refactor (PR 816544) and cross-cuts unified rollouts observability changes (PRs in this area listed in linked_linear).

review_comments: Evan Li: Please clarify how the QuarantineCoordinator interacts with manual quarantine (hold) API. Are we guaranteed not to overwrite a manual hold?
Author (Asha Patel): The coordinator treats manual holds with higher precedence. I added explicit logic and a unit test (test_manual_hold_precedence) to confirm behavior.

Priya Natarajan: The composite score weights look reasonable, but we should expose defaults and make thresholds configurable per-org. Also add a short description in the docs explaining how teams should tune weights.
Author: Exposed composite_weights and threshold config in rollout.spec.observability.compositeScore with sensible defaults. Added tuning guide in docs/probing-v2.md.
Mateo Ruiz: e2e looked flaky on first run (timeout in probe). Could we add adaptive timeout and a small backoff?
Author: Implemented adaptive timeout using recent latency p95; added probe_retry_count metric and backoff. Re-ran e2e and the flakiness resolved.
Jordan Kim: Observability fields are good; please ensure dashboards include the new metric for canary alerts. Approved after CI green.
Evan Li: Approving — verified staging run and manual safety checks.

release_notes: Enhanced quarantine and probing for unified rollouts: safer autorollback with composite-metric quorum, adaptive probe timeouts, and improved observability. Feature gated under rollout.spec.probing.v2. See docs/rollouts/probing-v2.md for tuning guidance.
notes_for_ops: When enabling probing.v2 for customers, watch 'composite_score' and 'rollback_decision_reason' metrics in stage for 48 hours. Default thresholds are conservative; increase sensitivity only after validating the canary baseline. If unexpected rollbacks occur, set rollout.spec.probing.v2 to false to revert behavior immediately.
